title: False gain hollows the one gaining it.
summary: Counterfeit dealings do not merely fail externally. They shape a counterfeit self internally.
takeaway: Success that distorts the soul is loss.
lifeApplication: Refuse one shortcut today because of what it would make you become, not only because it might get caught.

source.shortMeaning: False commerce makes the whole person false.
source.lifeApplication: Integrity is part of spiritual survival, not optional polish.

evidence.coreClaim: False commerce makes the whole person false.
evidence.turn: Invest in what crosses the threshold with you.
evidence.practicalImplication: Refuse one shortcut today because of what it would make you become, not only because it might get caught.
